posts.text: i have been a coffee guy for 15 years
these look incredible. how hot are you getting your oven for these pies?
they thought it was very cool and loved the pizza
oh i get it. for a solid two years sourdough was my main hobby
the neat thing about this is that you can use wood as well!
basically i didn’t want a single use device. the gozney dome is a large outdoor oven. also, my local kitchen supply store was selling one for 10% off + 10% off on all accessories
with the gas, as hot as 900 degrees. you can use wood as well, and then it can get to 1000
new outdoor oven (large enough to bake bread in!), first two pizzas. very excited to work on my skills here.
